build_pointnet_set_abstraction: build a PointNetSetAbstraction module to sample and encode point cloud regions with MLP convolutions
build_pointnet_set_abstraction_msg: build a PointNetSetAbstractionMsg module to extract multi-scale group features from point clouds
build_pointnet_feature_propagation: build a PointNetFeaturePropagation module to interpolate and propagate features from sparse to dense points
run_farthest_point_sample: run farthest point sampling to select representative centroids from a point cloud tensor
run_sample_and_group: run sample_and_group to sample points and group nearby neighbors by radius or KNN
